ko.executive_summary: Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on next-generation automotive computers featuring Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride for automated driving and digital cockpits. MediaTek reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$168 billion (18.3% growth) with AI chip sales targeting $16 billion in 2027.
key_facts: Infineon + Qualcomm partnership on vehicle computers
MediaTek AI chip sales target 2027: $16 billion

implications.text: Infineon-Qualcomm collaboration signals accelerating adoption of advanced SoCs for autonomous and connected vehicle platforms, challenging pure-play automotive suppliers.
AI chip revenue target of $16 billion by 2027 positions MediaTek as significant player in AI inference/edge computing, diversifying beyond consumer AP.

ko.counterpoint: Automotive semiconductor adoption cycles remain long; time-to-production for these platforms extends beyond 2027.
